### 3. Shelters stay reachable?

19 candidate shelters (assumed) are in the AOI, from The Hunt School at [-99.338905,30.069998] near Hunt, through Ingram / Ingram Elementary School, First Presbyterian Church of Ingram, CityWest Church, Junction Highway Church of Christ, to the Kerrville-east cluster - Starkey Elementary, Trinity Baptist, Live Oak Church of Christ, St. Paul's, First Christian Church, Fred H. Tally Elementary, Impact Christian Fellowship, Nimitz Elementary, Southern Oaks Baptist, Grace Bible Chapel, Kingdom Hall, Riverside Church of Christ, Seventh-Day Adventist Church.

Flood-aware routing `compute_route` at `t_s` around peak could not be completed in this session - tool budget reached after the place stats.

What can be said from completed runs:

* Domain-wide 114.865 km impassable, 21.275 km in the South Fork corridor, 1-5.5 km impassable inside each camp polygon. In-model, evacuation along the South Fork should be assumed cut around peak at 6.5h.
* No shelter can be declared reachable without a route check. If you need it, re-run with specific `origin` + `t_s` + `run_id: r_9fa570dcc6a69fab` for:
  1. Mystic / Heart O' the Hills -> The Hunt School
  2. Mystic / Heart O' the Hills -> Ingram Elementary / First Presbyterian Church of Ingram
  3. La Junta / Waldemar / Hunt -> The Hunt School

data.title: South Fork Guadalupe historic flood replay for summer camps and shelter access
data.summary: Replay of the early July historic Guadalupe flood with gauged river inflows built in shows severe and life threatening flooding along the South Fork corridor and at all assessed summer camps, with deep inundation and extensive impassable roads across the study area. Camp Mystic sites along the South Fork and Heart O the Hills show deep inundation with many buildings affected, while upstream boys and girls camps near Hunt also flood with major road disruption. Shelter reachability by road could not be confirmed with routing in this replay, so planners should treat riverside roads as impassable and favour high ground shelters outside the floodplain for evacuation planning.
